decisions.reason: As a data-driven analysis tool that builds on the firm's existing platform, databases and pricing know-how and was given its own webpage, it likely remains a low-cost option worth keeping while demand potential becomes clearer.

This gas tariff comparison offer is very close to the firm's core capabilities, was actively presented on its own page and should be cheap to maintain relative to its strategic fit, so management would likely keep it.

A regional electricity tariff calculator fits the firm's established calculation and market-data business and, with its own webpage, still looks like a live option rather than a resolved disappointment.

Although only mentioned on the website and therefore less strongly backed in marketing, this product line still extends the core platform and can be retained as a moderately costly option until market acceptance is clearer.

The area definition tool complements tariff and regional process solutions, appears to reuse existing data assets and was given a dedicated page, so the option value of keeping it likely exceeds its carrying cost.

This site-specific tariff comparison line is strategically close to the core business but, because it was only mentioned on the website and involves several models, it faces a higher pruning risk even though management would still more likely keep it for now.
